messages:
sre-rotation-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate (eu-west). Smart-router reports repeated fallback events. Escalation: P1. Notifying oncall: jay

jay (oncall): acked, grabbing it now

jay (oncall): quick look — we have cascading 502/504. Traces show redwood-base-32q returning 502 and requests are being routed to redwood-base-8q in us-west as fallback, which then times out and bounces back to eu. Looks like fallback targets are within same capacity groups so requests are shuttling and amplifying.

kevin: confirming logs show a single high-volume customer (acct_98765) whose SDK retries aggressively: no jitter, immediate retry on 5xx after 150ms. Their retry behavior + our failover is doubling traffic into the pools.

maria: quick stats dump:
- baseline RPS: ~11k -> observed ~34k peak
- overall error rate: 0.6% -> 12.7%
- p95 latency: 280ms -> 1600ms

maria: seg of logs for clarity:
```
2026-03-15T22:03:10Z | region:eu-west | model:redwood-base-32q | 502 | fallback->redwood-base-8q (region:us-west)
2026-03-15T22:03:10Z | region:us-west | model:redwood-base-8q | timeout | fallback->redwood-base-32q (region:eu-west)
2026-03-15T22:03:11Z | region:eu-west | model:redwood-base-32q | 502 | fallback->redwood-base-8q (region:us-west)
```

jay (oncall): hypothesis: client retries without backoff + router failover policy that allows cross-region fallback into overlapping pools = amplification loop / thundering herd. Need quick mitigations: break fallback, slow the client, and add server-side retry limits.

kevin: mitigation plan: 1) disable smart-routing fallback for redwood-base-32q temporarily; 2) apply per-customer ingress cap for acct_98765; 3) enforce server retry budget to curb cascade; 4) add capacity in eu-west to relieve queueing.

jay (oncall): running command: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --model redwood-base-32q --mode disabled --reason "INC-2026-xyz"`

ops-bot: succeeded — fallback disabled for redwood-base-32q (smart-routing). change_id=cfg-9012

maria: 90s after disabling fallback: errors dropped from 12.7% -> 4.2%, p95 now ~720ms. Progress but still above SLO.

kevin: applying rapid throttle: `ratelimit update --customer acct_98765 --limit 60rps --scope ingress` and updating edge to return Retry-After + no-retry header to SDKs we know.

kevin: setting server retry caps: `config set retries.max_concurrent=20 retries.per_minute=600` across api-gateway.

deploy-bot: scaling action triggered: add 3 inference nodes to pool eu-west (job infra-scale-9023) — completed

maria: 8 minutes post mitigations:
- RPS: 13k
- error rate: 0.35%
- p95: 310ms
System appears stable.

jay (oncall): updating status page: "Degraded — elevated errors for a subset of customers; mitigations applied." Downgrading severity to P2. Notifying CS to reach affected customers.

kevin: will draft postmortem and action items now: suggested follow-ups:
- audit all smart-routing fallback maps to ensure targets are in different capacity groups or cold-spares
- implement cross-pool circuit breakers that stop cascading failovers once a threshold of concurrent failovers is hit
- add detection alert that correlates sudden retry-rate increases per-customer with fallback events and region oscillations
- update SDK guidance to require exponential backoff + randomized jitter and publish a migration note for large customers
- add server-side protection to annotate rejected requests so SDKs can backoff correctly

maria: test plan for postmortem: simulate aggressive client with no-jitter retries against model 32q, induce a host-level timeout to trigger fallback and measure amplification factor. Repeat with jitter/backoff and with server retry caps.

emily: taking watch for 30m. Closure criteria: error rate <0.5% and p95 <350ms sustained for 30m. I will re-open if regression observed.

jay (oncall): handing off monitoring to emily in 25m. Thanks team. Closing after watch passes. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident logged as INC-2026-078, timeline available.

kevin: assigning action items to infra and router teams in PM: PRs for routing hotpath, unit tests for fallback selection, and dashboard that surfaces correlated retry+fallback spikes.

jay (oncall): final note — add a safety to smart-router: prefer fallback targets outside original pool and avoid immediate cross-region swaps. Also consider adding jittered server-side delay before failing over.

emily: ack, monitoring steady at 30m mark, closing incident in 10m if stable.
